rows.quest:8149:progress:0: Have you made the journey to Uther's Tomb and placed the tribute there?⟦44⟧⟦45⟧It can be a dangerous trip for less experienced adventurers; a safer way of traveling there, relatively speaking, may be to travel north from the river that runs through Hillsbrad into the ⟦E34⟧. It flows from a lake that is adjacent to Sorrow Hill; travel west up through the hills, steering clear of the adjacent tomb... one that is infested with the Scourge.
rows.quest:8149:completion:0: He was a hero among heroes, Uther was. I can't even begin to imagine the anguish of what he felt when ⟦E35⟧ - his greatest student and someone whom Uther loved like his own son - betrayed all of humanity. Still, he rose to try and stop ⟦E35⟧, and for that he will be forever remembered as a true paladin. His fight was to the end, thinking only of those he might save.
rows.quest:8149:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦46⟧. You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.
rows.quest:8150:obj:0: ⟦E30⟧ to Grom's Monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of ⟦E37⟧ and use ⟦E38⟧ at the base of the monument. Return to ⟦E39⟧ outside ⟦E4⟧ before the Harvest Festival is over.
rows.quest:8150:details:0: During the Harvest Festival of ⟦E5⟧, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. The ⟦E40⟧ acknowledges many heroes, but none exemplify strength and sacrifice more than ⟦E41⟧.
rows.quest:8150:details:1: Help us honor Grom by taking this offering to his monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of ⟦E37⟧. Place it at the base, and then return to me. I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Grom his tribute.
rows.quest:8150:progress:0: Have you made the journey to Grom's Monument and placed his tribute there?⟦47⟧⟦48⟧The site where the monument is still touched by the taint of the ⟦E42⟧. Should you be less experienced in the ways of adventuring, be on your toes when approaching the monument.
rows.quest:8150:completion:0: Grom's full name - Grommash - means "The Giant's Heart"; it took that and more to stand alone against Mannoroth. I think the Warchief said it best when the curse of the orcs began and ended with Grom. Fitting that Grom's sacrifice - and perhaps redemption - would be the wellspring from which the ⟦E40⟧ flows today.
rows.quest:8150:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦49⟧. You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.
rows.quest:8311:obj:0: Speak with the innkeepers of ⟦E44⟧, ⟦E2⟧, and ⟦E45⟧, as well as ⟦E46⟧ in ⟦E2⟧. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.
rows.quest:8311:obj:1: Return to ⟦E47⟧ at the ⟦E44⟧ Orphanage with a ⟦E48⟧, ⟦E49⟧, ⟦E50⟧, and ⟦E51⟧.
rows.quest:8311:details:0: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!
rows.quest:8311:details:1: Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! Also, a little gnome named Talvash in ⟦E2⟧ is handing out candy as well. When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
rows.quest:8311:progress:0: Have you finished trick-or-treating yet?  I'm sad that I can't go because I'm sick, but you helping me out makes me feel a little better...
rows.quest:8311:completion:0: Wow, you got them all! You're awesome!
rows.quest:8311:completion:1: Thank you for trick-or-treating for me. Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!
